plugin.name: Meshy
plugin.description: Generate, texture, remesh and animate 3D models with Meshy.
plugin.longDescription: Optional Beta for your Meshy API account. Includes text and image generation, remeshing, texturing, reusable character rigs, library animations, balance and editable model versions. Requires OhMyGame API 2.16.
config.key.title: Meshy API key
config.key.description: Create an API key in your Meshy account. Generation and processing use your Meshy credits.
